name: USB-C power in
note: No copper change. J1 CPL point is its pad centre (1.497 mm from origin), pin A1 north-west. U1 +180 (UNVERIFIED). JLC solders shell pegs.

name: Input protection
note: No copper change. D1 cathode band west, no correction. F1 not polarised. The via in F1.1 is in the POFV list.

name: On/off controller
note: No copper change. U3 gets SOT-23 +180 by analogy (UNVERIFIED). SW1-SW3 no correction (90 deg would be wrong). Q2/Q3 +180.

name: Regulators
note: Assembly PDF: TP names and net texts overlap; TH1-TH4 printed over holes. Readability only, TPs/THs are not assembled.

name: RV1106G3 SoC
note: U9 QFN-128 +270 (JLC 0), pin 1 SW corner (UNVERIFIED). 16 EP vias named in POFV remark. Drill/place origin moved to panel lower-left.

name: 24 MHz clock
note: Y1 no correction (90 deg would be wrong, 180 does not matter). Y2 not polarised. The via in C58 is in the POFV list.

name: SPI NAND
note: U10 (WSON-8) gets +270 (UNVERIFIED). Pin 1 must be at its north-west.

name: microSD
note: J2 no correction; CPL point is pad centre (2.195 mm from origin). Q4 +180. Vias in R40 and TP16 are in the POFV list.

name: Ethernet RJ45
note: The RJ45 J3 is through-hole, placed and soldered by JLC, no correction; its CPL point is the pad centre.

name: USB-A host
note: U2/U8 +180, U11 +270, C35 +180 with + to the south (all UNVERIFIED). The USB-A J4 is through-hole, placed by JLC.

name: Expansion header
note: order-notes.md lacks the answer to JLC's 'mark on PCB' option, and a warning that J5/J6 preview models may show 90 deg off.

name: Debug UART
note: The 1x3 header J6 is through-hole, placed by JLC; its CPL point is the pad centre.

name: Buttons & LEDs
note: LED1-3: cathode to the west, no correction (UNVERIFIED). The 19 F.Fab-only references appear in assembly-top-refs.pdf.
